integrity: The source model and established independent-set equilibrium feasibility are attributed; the new claim concerns exact global initial-support selection, exponential convergence and extinction clocks. Analytical derivation with a standalone finite checker; independent scientific review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic finite directed chain, strictly positive predation strengths, uniform intrinsic reproduction and mortality with r>d. No claim for spatial or stochastic dynamics, heterogeneous intrinsic coefficients, or uniform asymptotic constants.
title: Global greedy independent-set selection and exact extinction rates in hierarchical May–Leonard chains
